scope: Existing T2340 A50 visit1000 FM vs B20 ten-step prefix-risk cotangents; CPU only. New S/P/D uses other flow seeds; this is a separate local diagnostic, not its exact first-step forecast. No optimizer update or policy inference. Pairwise Gram uses chunked FP64 accumulation because an initial long-vector FP32 reduction yielded diagonal cosine 1.001; this is arithmetic only, not a model dtype intervention. Negative cosine implies adverse SGD risk derivative. Adam-direction ignores decay and changes in clipping/epsilon; finite effects require actual learning.

public_B0_reader_execution_decomposition.scope: All saved T2340 train-only conditions. e=raw generated-B cotangent; t=saved public B0 gradient; r=t-e estimates native-reader gradient. Q/V public gradients were accumulated in BF16, so subtraction includes rounding. action_in/out are FP32; action_out has no native-reader path and is a negative control. No new model computation, gradient or optimizer update.

two_teacher_prediction_error_decompositi.scope: CPU arithmetic on saved B20, identical query/noise/target for both teachers. Pair centroid is only an algebraic reference; no averaged LoRA or deployable ensemble is proposed. Two teachers do not estimate total population teacher variance reliably. MSE is not closed-loop success.

contract.question: Do existing full-T-conditioned teacher features support a better learned additive action_out correction than existing public-beta teacher features, at matched 7x256 readout capacity?
contract.scope: CPU only; existing train tasks 0,12,20,32 and two teachers each; no GPU, backbone forward, original checkpoint mutation, B20, environment, held or formal launch. Distinct from withdrawn section 30.
contract.model: Keep original full T2340 predictions and action_out query inputs. Recompute Z from existing H/X using unchanged checkpoint A/P/C/D and original TargetWrite recursion. Add Gamma Z A q at action_out, Gamma initially zero. Compare native-beta and native-full-T read features. This is exact additive final-layer FM algebra at stored query inputs, up to numerical execution differences; not a ten-step or closed-loop test.
contract.fit: One fixed ridge setting: lambda = 0.001 * trace(X^T X) / 256, no bias; all 50 horizon positions and 7 action dimensions. Double precision CPU solve; not a model precision change. No tuning after outcomes.
contract.primary: Four leave-one-task-out fits, each train on all A28 queries and both teachers of three tasks and score fourth task. All tasks are authorized training tasks; held-out means only withheld from this small readout fit.
contract.secondary: Two cross-episode folds: first 14 A queries vs final 14, reversed, shared across all four tasks and both teachers.
contract.readback: Preserve paired per-task/teacher full50 and first5/motion/gripper MSE, training error and head norms. Prefer conditional reading only if its advantage transfers to withheld tasks, not merely training or same-task episodes. Negative result weakens this fixed-feature readout hypothesis, not arbitrary end-to-end rereading. Any positive result is local mechanism evidence only.
contract.time: Expected a few CPU minutes; stop if missing required cached arrays or computation exceeds 5 minutes. No additional capture or repair of canceled experiment.

free_B_interpretive_control.scope: Follow-up interpretive control after both conditional readout fits failed. Same fixed ridge fraction 0.001, no tuning. Free action_out B uses 7x128 parameters and no Z. Task-private B is a privileged diagnostic, not a deployment candidate. Same exact single-FM final-layer algebra, not real ten-step or closed-loop.

value_reachability.scope: Fixed saved T2340 keys, exact arbitrary-Value linear map. Does not grant arbitrary V to the trained Writer or evaluate any policy. A28 actual 10-step consumers and separately independent B20 cotangents.
